name: senja
description: 12 shared tools for current Senja testimonials, links and invites, isolated project profiles, exact reviewed batches and bounded private exports.
long_description: Current public REST companion with shared task CLI and local stdio MCP. Mandatory local confirmation for writes and exports, direct read-only enforcement, isolated Bearer API keys and no browser/session import or automatic retries. Senja also offers its own hosted MCP, including invites and links.

api_key.title: Intended project API key
api_key.description: Private Bearer API key from the intended Senja project. Choose this or token_file. Never paste it into a repository.

token_file.title: Private API key file
token_file.description: Absolute owner-private regular non-symlink file outside repositories. Choose instead of api_key; restrict Windows ACLs.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide and directly refuse writes, invite emails, batch execution and file exports.
